source_report_body:
CHECK-052 complete. All 88,750 numerical field comparisons and 326 printed table cells match; eight independent checks pass. No owner code was accessed. Sixteen owner-output pins and 252 non-executable input pins verify.

R10 ISA least S/F/J reproduces 1.055318 GPa compression, 5.343008 GPa ply strength (92.12%), retention .861568874 and sleeves 45.874 kg. Water ingress 1.258056 kg/day gives the 32.5165 Pa crossing at 17.279789 h; ground schedule 15.551810 h. Dry onboard duty needs 15–148 pumps and fails every tested case. Ground closure remains R10 ISA/R12 optimistic; P2 comparison reproduces.

Two presentation corrections: 288 f5-5 sensitivity fields incorrectly say f5-019; METHOD’s 52.425 kg family difference rounds to 52.426 kg. Neither changes closure.

The order’s COMMON.md pin differs from the live file. Humidity crossings retain 284.9 K bulk gas; holding rates/cold-film target fixed at 320 K gives a counterfactual 15.321116 h crossing, not a validated weather case.

Four nonblocking checker findings, all 15 owner NFIs and 11 inherited registers are preserved. Qualified installed SF/life/Pf remain null. Released simjob receipts and exact comparisons are pinned. No successor.
